name: Curse Battlegrounds
desc:
Switch characters at the top left of your screen, there's a character icon.

CONTROLS:
M1 - Attack
F - Block
Q - Dash
Q (while ragdolled) - Ragdoll Cancel / Evasive
W + W - Run
G - Awakening / Ultimate
B - Emote Wheel

tale tells that there's a summit for you to reach

understand that this game is unlikely to get proper public updates, although it's got many aspects behind just a battlegrounds game, try PS+, climbing a mountain, fighting a spec? maybe even steel ball run.
